_comment: Snippet for ~/.claude.json (or a project-level .mcp.json). Merge the 'harness' entry into your existing 'mcpServers' object -- do not overwrite the whole file. Two examples are shown; use ONE per environment, not both under the same name.

harness._comment: Team HTTP mode (recommended): the server holds zero credentials. Replace <TEAM-INTERNAL-URL> with your VPC-internal HTTPS endpoint and <YOUR-SCOPED-HARNESS-SAT> with YOUR OWN Harness Service Account Token (or personal-identity-scoped token) -- never a shared team credential.

harness-local-stdio._comment: Local/dev single-user mode only -- NOT for shared team use, since it runs under one developer's own token. See harness-mcp-server/README.md 'Onboarding'.
